programme.title: The Agony and the Ecstasy

After a hit on his family , Armand goes into killer mode. Derrick and Vic Moore team up for revenge , but Rossi and his partner Qua stay ahead. When they involve Dr. Monica Gaye in the plot , she flips the script to survive. A devastating loss sends a grieving Armand past the point of no return , forcing him to eliminate every one of his opps.

programme.title: One-2

While working to take down HeavyHand, a local kingpin, Hart finds himself at the mercy of another known gangster, and find himself working with Tae & G to bring them down.

programme.title: Perc 30
programme.desc: Shavonne Perkins has taken control of the biggest Percocet operation in Houston, TX. Soon after the announcement, a price is put on the entire family's head. Bullets fly, lives are lost, and the family look to each other as to which one of them is responsible.

programme.title: Killer Zaddy
programme.desc: Naomi Anderson is struggling financially when she meets a successful, handsome, older gentleman.

programme.title: Intentions

programme.title: Men Pray Too
programme.desc: An ex-con tries to rebuild a life with his girlfriend. Can he start anew through the power of prayer?

programme.title: THREE

But what seems like a dream come true for Jayson, leads to jealousy, betrayal and a trail of broken hearts.

programme.title: My Plus Size Bachelorette

programme.title: Her Last Patient

programme.title: Dream on Dreamer
